cohort: The study included 98 women with axial spondyloarthropathy (62 with ankylosing spondylitis and 36 with non-radiographic axial spondyloarthropathy) and 99 healthy females.
finding: Women with axial spondyloarthropathy exhibited significantly worse sexual function, lower quality of life, higher depression and anxiety scores, and increased clitoral/labial atrophy and speculum pain compared to healthy controls, with no significant differences between AS and nr-axSpA subgroups.
cross-section timing: At the time of evaluation of existing rheumatologic disease in elderly women
